description: The idiomatic method_missing shape: `def method_missing(name, *args)`. Its true signature is 'one Sym, then zero or more of anything' -- and Ty's arrow spine (arrow0/arrowCons) has no vararg/rest-arity constructor at all. There is no Ty value that honestly describes this parameter list, not just no `chk` rule for it yet: arrow_of([Sym], ...) would be a lie about the real arity (it fits this one zero-extra-args call site while being wrong for `some_method(1, 2, 3)` elsewhere). FLAGGED ty_language_gap: Ty needs something like an `arrowRest (rest ret : Ty)` constructor, or modeling a rest param as `arrayOf Ty`, before this signature can be written down at all.
